tasks.short: Negotiate the remediation contract inside limits set before the meeting.

steps.what: Pull scope, rates and exclusions from the remediation bid.

loop.output: Rows for scope, rate, exclusion and clause
loop.check: The manager checks each rate against the bid
loop.stop: One pass; a rate with no unit stays blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Bids mix a schedule with marked-up clauses

steps.what: Mark contract clauses that differ from the standard terms.

loop.input: Bid clauses and the standard terms
loop.output: Deviation rows: clause, standard text, bid text
loop.check: The manager confirms a deviation is real, not a formatting change
loop.stop: One pass; an unclear clause is marked for the negotiation
loop.why_not_simpler: Clause wording is not a field the contract system already compares

steps.what: Set the limits for price, time and liability on this contract.
Negotiate the remediation contract inside those limits.
Write the agreed contract changes and send them.

loop.input: Notes of concessions and the limits
loop.check: The manager deletes a concession that exceeds the limit
loop.stop: One draft; a concession over the limit stops the send
loop.why_not_simpler: Concessions were spoken and are not a stored clause

steps.what: Counsel reviews a liability clause that is still nonstandard.

tasks.design: The bid is extracted and clauses are compared with the standard terms in the {CLM}. The manager sets limits, negotiates inside them, and sends agreed changes only within those limits. A nonstandard liability clause still goes to counsel.
tasks.previous_blocker: Positions lived in mail, so the manager reconstructed the bid before every call.
tasks.enabler_now: A clause can be marked against a standard. Trading it live cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Giving a concession on liability without seeing what the contractor will do next.
tasks.human_edge: The manager hears which rate the contractor will actually move.

ambition.what: Limits on price, time and liability are set before the call, and a concession past them is not sent.

tasks.altitude: Negotiation calls stay. Reconstructing the bid shrinks. The manager can stop a send that passes the limit.

reach.task: Set contract terms the organisation will not concede
reach.learn: Which liability and insurance terms need counsel before they are agreed

evidence.claim: Negotiating price and liability stays with the person in the room.
Marking a clause against a standard text is a comparison, not the negotiation.

assumptions: Focal role is the brownfield site manager. Counsel's review is not the manager's saving. Boundary: from a bid to an agreed-changes note. Signing the final contract may be a director.

Structured fields are scope, rate, exclusion, clause id and limit. The bid and the standard terms produce the comparison; the manager sets limits. Fallback: an unclear clause is marked for the call, not auto-accepted.
Use the {CLM} comparison if it exists before custom code.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers a standard term that changes.
The note is an external send. It cannot exceed the limits version taken into the call.
unknowns: Whether standard terms are already in the contract system.
Whether the manager may agree liability or only a director may.
research_questions: What share of bids use the standard terms with a price schedule only?
How often does a call end past the written limit?

incremental.description: Update standard terms when the organisation changes a clause

approvals.approved_version: negotiation limits taken into the call
agreed changes note within those limits

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: bids are marked-up scans and most calls reopen the limits, so preparation saves little. High: deviations are clear and only the note shrinks. The negotiation stays. Counsel time is not saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan structural demolition so debris removal does not spread contamination.

steps.what: Read structural condition and contamination limits before demolition.

loop.input: The structural survey and the contamination limits
loop.output: Rows for element, condition, contaminant and hold
loop.check: The manager checks each hold against the survey
loop.stop: One pass; an element with no condition stays blank

steps.what: Walk the structure and mark what demolition must leave.
Sequence demolition so contamination is not spread.
Draft the demolition method statement from that sequence.

loop.output: Method statement steps in that order
loop.check: The manager removes a step that is not in the sequence
loop.stop: One draft; an extra step is cut
loop.why_not_simpler: The statement must follow the sequence just set, not a generic demolition template

steps.what: Issue the demolition method statement to the contractor.
Contractor comments on whether the sequence can be built.

tasks.design: Survey limits are listed, then the manager walks the structure and sets the demolition sequence. The method statement follows that sequence and is issued only after the manager checks it. The contractor's comment comes back as their work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sequence and contamination holds were mixed into one drawing mark-up.
tasks.enabler_now: A survey can list elements and holds. Ordering the demolition so dust and water do not spread contamination cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Ordering the takedown so a contaminated element is controlled before the next one falls.
tasks.human_edge: The manager sees which wall will not stand once the neighbour element is gone.

ambition.what: The demolition sequence is set on site before a method statement is issued.

tasks.altitude: The walk stays. Rewriting a generic method shrinks. The manager can refuse a statement that adds a step the sequence does not have.

reach.task: Confirm the demolition sequence against the build programme
reach.learn: Which elements the build needs left standing

evidence.claim: A method statement that adds steps the sequence does not contain is a draft error, not a plan.
Walking a structure and ordering demolition stay with a person.

assumptions: Focal role is the brownfield site manager. The contractor's comment is not the manager's saving. Boundary: from the survey to an issued method statement. The physical demolition is the contractor's later work.
Structured fields are element, condition, contaminant and hold. The survey produces them. Fallback: an element with no condition is walked, not assumed sound.
Use the {DOCS} method-statement template before custom code.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers hold types when a contaminant is added.
Structural safety stays with the people who walked it. This design does not certify the structure.
unknowns: Whether a structural survey already exists as elements or only as a drawing.
Whether a structural engineer must sign the sequence.
research_questions: What share of elements have a stated condition before the walk?
How often does the contractor reject the sequence?

incremental.description: Add hold types when a new contaminant is in the survey

approvals.approved_version: method statement the manager checked against the sequence

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the survey is a drawing, so the list is made on the walk and the sequence is unchanged. High: elements are listed and only the statement shrinks. The walk and the sequence stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design a restoration study, and interpret results against its question.

steps.what: State the restoration question the study must answer.
Pull restoration sample results that already answer part of it.
Design restoration sample locations and methods.
Collect the restoration samples in the field.
Analyse the restoration samples.
Interpret the restoration results against the study question.
File the restoration study with the question and the results.

tasks.design: The manager states the question, and results already on file are pulled in {BI}. Sample locations are designed for what is still unknown. Field collection and the laboratory stay with them. The manager interprets the certificate against the question and files that pair.
tasks.previous_blocker: Studies started from a generic sample grid, so results arrived that answered no question.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored certificates can be listed against a question. Designing where to sample, and reading what the results mean, cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Writing a question the results can actually answer, rather than a question that is too wide.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows which part of the ground is still the uncertainty.

ambition.what: A study is opened only with a question, and results are filed against that question rather than as a loose certificate.

tasks.altitude: Interpretation stays. Hunting old certificates shrinks. The manager can refuse a sample design that does not serve the question.

reach.task: Say which restoration results a later inspection will ask for
reach.learn: Which results must be on the file before an inspection

evidence.claim: Pulling stored certificates that match a question is a records query.
Designing a restoration study and interpreting it stay with a person.

assumptions: Focal role is the brownfield site manager. Field sampling and laboratory analysis are not the manager's saving. Boundary: from a question to a filed interpretation. The revegetation plan is a later task.
Structured fields are question, location, method, analyte and result. The manager writes the question; the laboratory produces the result. Fallback: a result with no question is not filed as a study.
Configure the certificate query in {BI} before custom code.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers an analyte added to the study template.
The study does not set a regulatory limit. It answers the question that was written down.
unknowns: Whether old certificates are indexed by location and analyte.
Whether the field team is in-house or a supplier.
research_questions: What share of new studies are answered by certificates already on file?
How often is the question rewritten after the results?

incremental.description: Add analytes to the study template when the question type changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: nothing is indexed, so old results are not found and the study is designed and read by hand. High: certificates are indexed and only the pull shrinks. The question, the design and the interpretation stay. Field and laboratory time is not saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review a treatment or disposal facility design and send the comments.

steps.what: Extract the treatment facility's capacity, discharge and waste design.

loop.output: Rows for capacity, discharge limit, waste type and control
loop.check: The manager checks each row against the drawing or the specification
loop.stop: One pass; a control with no limit stays blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Designs mix drawings and specification prose

steps.what: Check the facility design against numeric disposal limits.
Judge whether this treatment or disposal design will work here.
Write and send review comments on the facility design.

loop.output: Comments that each cite a judgement point
loop.check: The manager deletes a comment that is not in the judgement
loop.stop: One draft; an extra comment is cut
loop.why_not_simpler: Comments must follow the judgement, not a generic design checklist

tasks.design: Capacity, discharge and waste type are extracted from the design, then checked against numeric limits. The manager judges whether it will work on this site. Comments are sent only from that judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Designs arrived as drawing sets, so limits were checked by eye in the meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: A numeric limit can be compared with a stated capacity. Whether the facility will work on this ground cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing a control that meets the number and still fails the waste this site actually has.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows the waste variability the design basis smoothed away.

ambition.what: A design is marked able or unable against the limits before comments are sent.

tasks.altitude: Review meetings stay. Hunting numbers in the drawing set shrinks. The manager can cut a comment the judgement does not support.

reach.task: Own the facility design the comments go back to
reach.learn: Which design assumptions are fixed and which the review may challenge

evidence.claim: Comparing a stated capacity with a numeric limit is a rules check.
Judging whether a treatment facility will work on this waste stays with the reviewer.

assumptions: Focal role is the brownfield site manager. Boundary: from a facility design to comments sent to the designer. Operating the facility is out of scope.
Structured fields are capacity, discharge, waste type, control and limit. The design produces the basis; the constraint list produces limits. Fallback: a control with no limit is not marked pass.
Configure the limit check before custom code.
Upkeep of 5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers a limit added to the check.
Comments are an external send. They wait on the judgement version.
unknowns: Whether designs arrive with a data sheet or only drawings.
Whether the designer expects comments in a set format.
research_questions: What share of design checks are numeric rather than a judgement on the waste?
How often is a design sent back more than once?

incremental.description: Add limits when the disposal standard changes

approvals.approved_version: design comments edited from the judgement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the design is drawings only, so the basis is retyped and the meeting does the review. High: the data sheet is complete and only the check and the comments shrink. The judgement stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still site walks, crew briefings and hearings. Constraint lists, permit fields and cost lines are ready before the visit. The manager can stop a method, a filing or a price that is not on a checked version.
reach: Construction managers: sequence demolition so contamination is not spread
Compliance managers: say which breaches are notified the same day
Regulatory affairs managers: keep the permit condition list current
skills_to_grow: Checking an extracted constraint against the source line
Reading a laboratory certificate without treating a blank as zero
Holding a filing or a price that is not the checked version
role.ambitious_version: Each site carries a versioned constraint list, each filing uses fields the manager has checked, and each on-site commitment stays inside a limit already signed.

job.title: Brownfield Redevelopment Specialists and Site Managers
